drafts.title: 🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, HALLOWEEN FINALE
drafts.text:
It's Halloween. The Lantern Witch lights her last flame tonight. Finale 🕯️👇

🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, HALLOWEEN FINALE 🕯️

The final night, the moon burns red,
she calls the lanterns of the dead.
A thousand flames rise through the sky,
and every soul gets one goodbye.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
The prompt is in the comments 👇
Which episode was your favorite?

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-12s. Second 0: the witch's single blue lantern in pitch black, then it splits into dozens of flames in one beat. Then a wide shot under a blood red moon: she stands on a hill above a graveyard as a thousand lanterns float up from the graves, pale ghost figures inside them wave once, and the last shot is her lantern going out as she smiles.

drafts.title: 🏰 THE CASTLE BUILT ON A DRAGON
drafts.text:
Hey @grok, explain it like I'm 10: why can't we build a castle like this? 🏰🐉👇

🏰 THE CASTLE BUILT ON A DRAGON 🏰

They built their towers on its spine,
through a thousand years of rain and brine.
Then on the night the bells rang ten,
the mountain opened its eyes again.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Want the prompt? Comment CASTLE 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s. Second 0: a slow drone push toward a gothic castle sitting on a mountain ridge in fog, lights in every window, so it looks real and impossible at once. Then a bell rings, the ridge cracks, and a giant golden eye opens in the rock under the castle walls as the whole mountain lifts and turns out to be a sleeping dragon.

drafts.title: 🎃 THE NIGHT THE SCARECROWS WALKED
drafts.text:
Every Halloween at midnight, the scarecrows leave the fields. Tonight is the night 🎃👇

🎃 THE NIGHT THE SCARECROWS WALKED 🎃

The clock struck twelve, the crows took flight,
the scarecrows left their poles tonight.
They crossed the road with pumpkin eyes,
and knocked on doors to claim their prize.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Would you open the door? Tell me below 👇
The prompt is in the comments.

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s. Second 0: extreme close-up of a burlap scarecrow face as two carved pumpkin eyes light up orange and a flock of crows bursts off its shoulders. Then a low shot of a line of scarecrows climbing off their poles and walking across a moonlit cornfield toward a village, ending on one of them knocking on a wooden door that slowly creaks open.
